agent_review.author: agent

findings.observed_fact: The clone whiteouted after Bushtank, Coppertop, Ohmnomnom, Croakatoa, and Birdlaw were lost; Eelektrik remained alive near 30 HP.
findings.next_test: Return to PC/Pokécenter preparation and produce a team that preserves a full-health Eelektrik converter before another clone.

findings.why_bad: The policy spent ten pivots around Ponyta and still lost Lildozer without creating a safe reserve line.
findings.improvement: Reject the current team for this clone and prepare a stronger Ponyta response plus a preserved Eelektrik converter.
findings.observed_fact: The opening damage sequence left Lildozer at 25 HP against Ponyta at 35 HP; no legal action safely completed the matchup with this roster state.
findings.next_test: Use the attached turn-5 state to verify the revised party/role plan before retrying.

findings.observed_fact: At Coppertop 35 HP versus Eelektrik 54 HP, the line switched to Bushtank at 26 HP; Razor Leaf and then Bite exposed Bushtank to Shock Wave and Mega Drain until it fainted.
findings.next_test: Rebuild party order and reserve objectives so Croakatoa or another verified converter reaches Eelektrik at usable HP.

findings.observed_fact: The line used 15 switches and 13 moves, with six allied faints before terminal loss.
findings.next_test: Compare the prepared roster with exact damage bounds and require a finite switch budget before the next clone.

findings.observed_fact: Ohmnomnom used Spark to remove Bibarel; Fake Out then Spark safely finished Ponyta after the forced flinch.
findings.next_test: Retain this opening/finisher behavior while changing the preparation plan.

findings.observed_fact: The fight required 28 verified actions and spent substantial time switching before terminal loss.
findings.next_test: Measure action count only after the revised team produces a safe win.

correct_choices: All 28 action results matched RAM-verified outcomes; no observation or execution mismatch was found.
Spark removed Bibarel, and Fake Out was used on Ponyta only after Ohmnomnom fresh entry.
agent_review.next_test: Do not launch another clone with the unchanged party or behavior bundle. Complete PC/Pokécenter preparation for a safe Ponyta response and a preserved Eelektrik converter, then create a revised bounded clone plan.
